The stUSDT-RWA Contract maintains the 1:1 exchange rate between stUSDT and USDT (special rules may apply), with a Rebase mechanism for continuous rewards distribution. faq_a1: stUSDT is a TRC-20 receipt token that can be obtained by staking USDT into stUSDT-RWA Contract on the TRON blockchain. It supports transfer and can be used in other DeFi protocols. The exchange rate between stUSDT and USDT is kept at 1:1 by the stUSDT-RWA Contract (special rules may apply).
faq_q2: How to get the stUSDT rewards?
faq_a2:
You can earn rewards by holding stUSDT. The platform periodically distributes rewards to stUSDT holders through the Rebase mechanism. Holders can observe their rewards growing as their stUSDT balance increases.
There are $10,000,000 emergency reserves in the pool that don't generate any reward.
faq_a3:
It is important to understand that all investments carry risks. The stUSDT platform always prioritizes security to minimize risks involved and selects blue-chip RWAs as allocation targets. stUSDT creates the smart contract, builds asset management mechanism, as well as sets the investment strategy and data disclosure policy through RWA DAO.
USDT, on the other hand, is issued and managed by Tether. You can visit
faq_a3_2: to learn more about USDT for better-informed decisions.
faq_q4: What is the Rebase APY of stUSDT?
faq_a4:
Rebase APY indicates the annualized yield rate of stUSDT holders under the Rebase mechanism. As RWA rewards are distributed to stUSDT holders through the Rebase mechanism of the stUSDT-RWA Contract, holders can observe their rewards growing as their stUSDT balance increases. The rate at which rewards increase is determined by the appreciation of the RWA.
Note: There are $10,000,000 emergency reserves in the pool that don't generate any reward.
faq_q5: What fee does the stUSDT platform charge?
faq_a5: Staking USDT won't incur any fee. For unstaking, the stUSDT-RWA Contract will deduct a portion of your unstaking amount to cover the operational costs of the RWA investment.
